answer: By the mirror of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the wander until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the bridge of the next round. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
